Re: Anthropic
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Thursday, February 8, 2024 at 3:34:23 PM Eastern Standard Time
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Michel, Randi B. EOP/NSC
got it. I'll just copy you.
On Thu, Feb 8, 2024 at 3:33 PM Michel, Randi B. EOP/NSC < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Ok, good to go to get contacts. Let's just be super clear when you reach out that this is not a USG thing but rather we
are helping make the connection for ROK, who asked to get in touch. Thanks!
From: Lynn Lee < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, February 8, 2024 12:58 PM
To: Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Brian Vogt <[contact omitted]»; Michel, Randi B. EOP/NSC < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Nina Bowen
<[contact omitted]>
Subject: [EXTERNAL] RE: Anthropic
Thanks, Vera! I will wait to hear from you then.
Best,
Lynn
From: Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, February 8, 2024 12:02 PM
To: Lynn Lee < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Brian Vogt <[contact omitted]>; Michel, Randi B. EOP/NSC < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Nina Bowen
<[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Anthropic

Thanks so much, Lynn.
Let me write to my contacts today first.
Vera

On Thu, Feb 8, 2024 at 11:37 AM Lynn Lee < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Just to confirm, the names the Korean MOFA approved are Neal Mohan/Youtube and Dario Amodei/Anthropic. I will
write to the bigger group about other issues later today.
Thanks!
Lynn
From: Lynn Lee
Sent: Thursday, February 8, 2024 6:38 AM
To: Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Brian Vogt <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Anthropic
Dear Vera,
Just quickly, they want to invite both Anthropic and YouTube. Could you share their contact information with us? I
may ask for your help in receiving their response. The email invitation will go out from Damon Wilson, followed by the
Korean MoFA.
Thanks!
Lynn
Vera Zakem
Chief Digital Democracy and Rights Officer
Bureau for Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance
U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID)
